scope: Real local PostgreSQL 17 RPC JSON through production ShareRemote owner and anonymous strict decoders; SDK/fetch envelopes simulated.
limitations: No real PostgREST/HTTP or hosted Supabase connection

checks.name: actual SQL operation mismatch maps to a recoverable named error
actual SQL permission error does not become transport success
owner list excludes revoked pages and other accounts across cursor pages
actual SQL anonymous list permission error reaches owner decoder
update preserves URL, revoke clears it, and republish rotates it
SQL public envelope excludes private owner, workspace and operation identities
strict owner decoder rejects a stale public URL on revoked metadata
strict write decoder preserves the pending request for a malformed revoked result
strict owner decoder rejects extra snapshot data
strict visitor decoder rejects extra private identifiers
SQL/client validation parity: ordinary Korean and paired emoji
SQL/client validation parity: title exactly 500 UTF-16 units
SQL/client validation parity: title exceeds 500 UTF-16 units
SQL/client validation parity: ECMAScript whitespace-only title
SQL/client validation parity: control character in title
SQL/client validation parity: whitespace-only published text
SQL/client validation parity: valid Korean hostname
SQL/client validation parity: invalid URL port
SQL/client validation parity: out-of-range URL port
SQL/client validation parity: invalid bracketed URL host
SQL/client validation parity: out-of-range numeric IPv4 host
SQL/client validation parity: invalid bracketed IPv6 host
SQL/client validation parity: compact JSON exactly one MiB
SQL/client validation parity: compact JSON one byte beyond one MiB
rollback leaves account, page and receipt row counts unchanged
